column1: 今天几月几号？

column2: Today is May 9th.

column1: 今天星期几？
column2: What day is it today?

column2: What day of the week is June 25th?

column1: 星期日。
column2: Sunday.

column2: Sunday — great!

column1: 明天早上七点吃早饭。

column1: 现在几点？
column2: What time is it now?

column1: 现在八点十分。

column1: 现在九点十分。
column2: It's ten past nine.

column1: 请问，现在几点？
column2: Excuse me, what time is it now?

column1: 现在北京时间九点十分。
column2: It's ten past nine, Beijing time.

column1: 迎迎，你几点下班？
column2: Yingying, what time do you get off work?

column1: 我六点下班。你什么时候下课？
column2: I get off at six. When does your class finish?

column1: 我五点半下课。我们晚上一起吃饭吧。
column2: My class ends at five thirty. Let's have dinner together tonight.

column1: 好啊！现在几点？
column2: Sure! What time is it now?

column1: 现在差一刻九点。
column2: It's a quarter to nine.

column1: 哎呀，我九点上班。晚上见。
column2: Oh no, I start work at nine. See you tonight.

column1: 晚上几点见？
column2: What time shall we meet tonight?

column1: 六点二十。
column2: Six twenty.

column1: 妈，这是我男朋友大卫，他的汉语很好。
column2: Mom, this is my boyfriend David. His Chinese is very good.

column1: 欢迎！欢迎！
column2: Welcome! Welcome!

column1: 阿姨好！
column2: Hello, auntie!

column1: 大卫，你多大？
column2: David, how old are you?

column1: 我25岁。
column2: I'm 25 years old.

column1: 你家有几口人？
column2: How many people are in your family?

column1: 我家有四口人，爸爸、妈妈、姐姐和我。
column2: There are four people in my family: my dad, my mom, my older sister, and me.

column1: 你爸爸、妈妈做什么工作？
column2: What do your mom and dad do for work?

column1: 我爸爸是老师，妈妈是医生。
column2: My dad is a teacher and my mom is a doctor.

column1: 你姐姐……
column2: And your older sister...

column1: 妈！您的问题太多了！
column2: Mom! You're asking too many questions!

column1: 这是谁？
column2: Who is this?

column1: 这是我妹妹。
column2: This is my younger sister.

column1: 她是学生吗？
column2: Is she a student?

column1: 是。
column2: Yes.

column1: 她在哪儿学习？
column2: Where does she study?

column1: 她在北京大学学习。
column2: She studies at Peking University.

column1: 这是你弟弟吗？
column2: Is this your younger brother?

column1: 我没有弟弟，这是我哥哥。
column2: I don't have a younger brother; this is my older brother.

column1: 他也是学生吗？
column2: Is he a student too?

column1: 不是，他在银行工作。
column2: No, he works at a bank.

column1: 西瓜多少钱一斤？
column2: How much is watermelon per jin (half kilo)?

column1: 西瓜两块五一斤。
column2: Watermelon is 2.5 yuan per jin.

column1: 我要这个。
column2: I'll take this one.

column1: 好。十一块二。
column2: Okay. That's 11.2 yuan.

column1: 苹果怎么卖？
column2: How are the apples sold?

column1: 苹果十块钱三斤。
column2: Apples are 10 yuan for three jin.

column1: 要三斤。
column2: I'll take three jin.

column1: 好。一共二十一块二，二十一吧。
column2: Okay. That's 21.2 yuan in total — let's just say 21.

column1: 您买什么？
column2: What would you like to buy?

column1: 我要两瓶矿泉水。
column2: I'd like two bottles of mineral water.

column1: 给。还要别的吗？
column2: Here you go. Anything else?

column1: 面包多少钱一个？
column2: How much is one loaf of bread?

column1: 六块钱一个。
column2: Six yuan each.

column1: 要一个。一共多少钱？
column2: I'll take one. How much is it in total?

column1: 十块。
column2: Ten yuan.

column1: 四块？
column2: Four yuan?

column1: 您好！请问，洗手间在哪儿？
column2: Hello! Excuse me, where is the restroom?

column1: 往左拐，一直走。
column2: Turn left and go straight.

column1: 好的，谢谢！
column2: Okay, thank you!

column1: 您好！请问，105房间在哪儿？
column2: Hello! Excuse me, where is room 105?

column1: 往前走，然后往右拐。
column2: Go straight, then turn right.

column1: 您好！请问，国家图书馆怎么走？
column2: Hello! Excuse me, how do I get to the National Library?

column1: 对不起，我也不知道。
column2: Sorry, I don't know either.

column1: 从这儿往南走，第二个路口往左拐。
column2: From here go south and turn left at the second intersection.

column1: 往南走，第二个路口，左拐。
column2: Go south, second intersection, turn left.

column1: 然后一直走到头，往右拐，再往前走500米，国家图书馆在马路西边。
column2: Then go straight to the end, turn right, walk another 500 meters, and the National Library is on the west side of the road.

column1: 马路西边。好的，谢谢！请问，这边是西边吗？
column2: West side of the road. Okay, thank you! Excuse me, is this way west?

column1: 你想吃包子还是饺子？
column2: Do you want to eat baozi or dumplings?

column1: 我都不想吃。咱们吃面条儿吧。
column2: I don't want either. Let's have noodles.

column1: 我不想吃面条儿。我最近每天都吃面条儿。
column2: I don't want noodles. I've been eating noodles every day lately.

column1: 那你想吃什么？
column2: Then what do you want to eat?

column1: 吃比萨，怎么样？
column2: How about pizza?

column1: （女朋友看到了比萨广告）
column2: (His girlfriend sees a pizza ad.)

column1: 好主意。今天特价。
column2: Good idea. There's a special today.

column1: 太好了！
column2: Great!

column1: 欢迎光临！请问，您想喝点儿什么？
column2: Welcome! What would you like to drink?

column1: 您好！我要一杯红茶。
column2: Hello! I'd like a cup of black tea.

column1: 好的。您要大杯还是小杯？
column2: Sure. Would you like a large or a small?

column1: 大杯。
column2: A large one.

column1: 今天这种蛋糕特价，您要一块儿吗？
column2: This cake is on special today. Would you like a piece?

column1: 真便宜，要一块儿。
column2: That's really cheap — I'll take a piece.

column1: 好的。您刷卡还是付现金？
column2: Okay. Will you pay by card or cash?

column1: 刷卡。
column2: By card.

column1: 你好，我叫爱华，我住11层，1107。
column2: Hi, my name is Aihua. I live on the 11th floor, room 1107.

column1: 我住1106，很高兴认识你！
column2: I live in 1106. Nice to meet you!

column1: 认识你我也很高兴！这是你的小狗吗？
column2: Nice to meet you too! Is this your puppy?

column1: 是啊。它叫“小胖”。
column2: Yes. Its name is "Xiaopang" (Little Chubby).

column1: 它眼睛真大！太可爱了。
column2: Its eyes are so big! So cute.

column1: （狗向前迈了一步）
column2: (The dog takes a step forward.)

column1: 别担心！
column2: Don't worry!

column1: 没关系，我很喜欢小猫、小狗。
column2: It's fine, I really like cats and dogs.

column1: 姐姐，爸妈身体怎么样？
column2: Sis, how are Mom and Dad doing?

column1: 爸妈身体都很好。你放心吧！
column2: Mom and Dad are both very well. Don't worry!

column1: 对了，我想看你新男朋友的照片。
column2: By the way, I'd like to see a photo of your new boyfriend.

column1: （姐姐给她看一张照片）
column2: (The older sister shows her a photo.)

column1: 他个子真高！
column2: He's so tall!

column1: 他是健身教练。
column2: He's a fitness trainer.

column1: 他工作忙不忙？
column2: Is he busy at work?

column1: 他工作非常忙，周末也不休息。
column2: He's very busy at work; he doesn't even rest on weekends.

column1: 你喜欢唱歌吗？
column2: Do you like singing?

column1: 我喜欢听歌，唱歌唱得不太好。
column2: I like listening to songs, but I don't sing very well.

column1: 我喜欢唱歌、看电影、旅游、打网球……
column2: I like singing, watching movies, traveling, playing tennis...

column1: 是吗？你的爱好真多！
column2: Really? You have so many hobbies!

column1: 你有什么爱好？
column2: What hobbies do you have?

column1: 我也喜欢网球，不过我不会打。
column2: I like tennis too, but I don't know how to play.

column1: 没关系，我教你。
column2: No problem, I'll teach you.

column1: 请进。请坐。
column2: Come in. Please have a seat.

column1: 您好！我叫大树。
column2: Hello! My name is Dashu.

column1: 你好，大树。你的特长是什么？
column2: Hi, Dashu. What are your special skills?

column1: 我会说四种语言：英语、法语、意大利语和汉语。
column2: I can speak four languages: English, French, Italian, and Chinese.

column1: 你的汉语说得不错，你会唱汉语歌吗？
column2: You speak Chinese well. Can you sing Chinese songs?

column1: 会，我唱汉语歌唱得还可以。
column2: Yes, I sing Chinese songs pretty well.

column1: 好。除了这些，你还有什么特长？
column2: Good. Besides these, what other skills do you have?

column1: 我还会中国功夫。
column2: I also know Chinese kung fu.

column1: 你去过上海吗？假期我们一起去上海吧。
column2: Have you been to Shanghai? Let's go to Shanghai together during the holiday.

column1: 我以前去过上海。
column2: I've been to Shanghai before.

column1: 杭州呢？你去过杭州吗？
column2: What about Hangzhou? Have you been to Hangzhou?

column1: 杭州我也去过。
column2: I've been to Hangzhou too.

column1: 你还去过哪儿？
column2: Where else have you been?

column1: 我还去过西安、昆明、广州……
column2: I've also been to Xi'an, Kunming, Guangzhou...

column1: 你去过的地方真多啊！
column2: You've been to so many places!

column1: 咱们中午订外卖吧。
column2: Let's order takeout for lunch.

column1: 好，我上网看看。这家怎么样？
column2: Sure, I'll look online. How about this place?

column1: 我去过这家饭馆儿，菜都很辣。
column2: I've been to this restaurant; the food is all very spicy.

column1: 这家西餐厅吧，我吃过，味道不错。
column2: How about this Western restaurant? I've eaten there; the food is good.

column1: 这家我上个星期订过，送得特别慢，别订这家。
column2: I ordered from this one last week; delivery was really slow. Don't order from here.

column1: 这家上海菜很有名，我还没吃过呢。
column2: This Shanghai restaurant is famous; I haven't tried it yet.

column1: 我也没吃过，可以试试。
column2: I haven't tried it either. Let's give it a try.

column1: 周末你去哪儿了？
column2: Where did you go over the weekend?

column1: 我跟同学一起去郊区滑雪了。
column2: I went skiing in the suburbs with a classmate.

column1: 滑雪？好玩儿吗？
column2: Skiing? Was it fun?

column1: 很好玩儿，那儿的滑雪场特别棒，人也不多。
column2: It was great fun. The ski resort there is excellent, and it wasn't crowded.

column1: 我还没滑过雪呢。难不难？
column2: I've never skied before. Is it hard?

column1: 不难，你不怕摔就行。下次我请你去。
column2: It's not hard, as long as you're not afraid of falling. Next time I'll take you.

column1: 我想想吧。
column2: Let me think about it.

column1: 星期天你都干什么了？
column2: What did you do on Sunday?

column1: 几个朋友来我家吃饭了。
column2: A few friends came to my place for dinner.

column1: 你会做饭吗？
column2: Can you cook?

column1: 我们要求每个人带一个菜。
column2: We asked everyone to bring one dish.

column1: 这真是个好办法！你也做菜了吗？
column2: That's a great idea! Did you cook something too?

column1: 做了。你猜我做什么了。
column2: Yes. Guess what I made.

column1: 一定是沙拉。
column2: It must be salad.

column1: 请进。
column2: Come in.

column1: 诺敏，你怎么还不起床？今天不上课吗？
column2: Nuomin, why aren't you up yet? Don't you have class today?

column1: 我有点儿不舒服。
column2: I feel a little unwell.

column1: 怎么了？
column2: What's wrong?

column1: 我头很疼，觉得特别冷。
column2: My head really hurts and I feel very cold.

column1: 是不是发烧了？量量体温吧。
column2: Do you have a fever? Let's take your temperature.

column1: 我现在只想睡觉。
column2: Right now I just want to sleep.

column1: 38度5。还是去医院看看吧。
column2: 38.5 degrees. You'd better go to the hospital.

column1: 哪儿不舒服？
column2: Where does it hurt?

column1: 头疼，发烧。
column2: Headache and fever.

column1: 先去验血吧。
column2: Let's do a blood test first.

column1: （诺敏拿着化验报告回来给大夫看）
column2: (Nuomin comes back with the lab report to show the doctor.)

column1: 你感冒了。吃这种感冒药，一天三次，一次两片。
column2: You have a cold. Take this cold medicine, three times a day, two tablets each time.

column1: 好的。
column2: Okay.

column1: 多喝水，多休息，少吃辣的菜。
column2: Drink more water, get more rest, and eat less spicy food.

column1: 谢谢大夫！
column2: Thank you, doctor!

column1: 喂，你好！
column2: Hello?

column1: 诺敏，我是西田。你在干吗呢？
column2: Nuomin, it's Nishida. What are you doing?

column1: 我正在跑步呢。有事吗？
column2: I'm running right now. What's up?

column1: 我和大卫打算晚上去看球，你来吗？
column2: David and I are planning to watch a game tonight. Do you want to come?

column1: 好啊。什么时候出发？
column2: Sure. When do we set off?

column1: 我现在在外边吃饭呢，6点半在宿舍门口见，怎么样？
column2: I'm out eating right now. Let's meet at the dorm entrance at six thirty, okay?

column1: 好，不见不散。
column2: Okay, see you there for sure.

column1: 你还在睡觉吗？都11点了。
column2: Are you still sleeping? It's already eleven o'clock.

column1: 我昨天去看球了，睡得很晚。
column2: I went to watch a game yesterday and went to bed very late.

column1: 昨天晚上我给你打电话一直没人接。
column2: I called you last night but no one answered.

column1: 不好意思，你给我打电话的时候，我正在看球呢。
column2: Sorry, when you called I was watching the game.

column1: 下午两点跟我们一起去打篮球吧。
column2: Come play basketball with us at two this afternoon.

column1: 不行啊，我得去机场接朋友。
column2: I can't; I have to pick up a friend at the airport.

column1: 那好吧，我们下次再约。
column2: All right then, let's arrange it another time.

column1: 今天天气真热！
column2: The weather is really hot today!

column1: 是啊。莫斯科的夏天也很热吗？
column2: Yes. Are summers in Moscow hot too?

column1: 那儿比北京凉快。
column2: It's cooler there than in Beijing.

column1: 听说莫斯科的冬天冷极了，是吗？
column2: I heard winters in Moscow are extremely cold. Is that true?

column1: 是，比北京冷多了。
column2: Yes, much colder than Beijing.

column1: 大概多少度？
column2: About how many degrees?

column1: 最低气温零下二十多度，不过我们习惯了，不怕冷。我冬天还在外边游过泳呢！
column2: The lowest temperature is more than twenty below zero, but we're used to it and don't mind the cold. I've even gone swimming outside in winter!

column1: 你看，又下雨了！
column2: Look, it's raining again!

column1: 是啊，最近常常下雨。
column2: Yes, it rains a lot lately.

column1: 今年的雨比去年多多了。
column2: There's been much more rain this year than last year.

column1: 你看天气预报了吗？明天天气怎么样？
column2: Did you check the weather forecast? What's the weather like tomorrow?

column1: 天气预报说，明天的雨比今天更大。
column2: The forecast says tomorrow's rain will be even heavier than today's.

column1: 那咱们明天的足球比赛怎么办啊？
column2: Then what do we do about our football match tomorrow?

column1: 那只能下周再比了。
column2: Then we'll have to play it next week.

column1: 前面就是咱们学校最大的教学楼。
column2: Up ahead is our school's largest teaching building.

column1: 国际学生办公室就在楼里，是吗？
column2: The international students' office is in this building, right?

column1: 是的。国际学生办公室在教学楼三层。
column2: Yes. The international students' office is on the third floor of the teaching building.

column1: 听说办公室里有位特别帅的老师。
column2: I heard there's a really handsome teacher in the office.

column1: 请向前走。左边是食堂，右边是网球场。
column2: Go straight ahead. On the left is the cafeteria, and on the right is the tennis court.

column1: 请问图书馆在哪儿？
column2: Excuse me, where is the library?

column1: 图书馆在食堂对面。看，足球场右边就是图书馆。
column2: The library is across from the cafeteria. Look, the library is right next to the football field on the right.

column1: 学校附近有超市吗？
column2: Is there a supermarket near the school?

column1: 有，学校东边就有一个大超市，买东西很方便。
column2: Yes, there's a big supermarket just east of the school; it's very convenient for shopping.

column1: 学校东门附近有一家新开的咖啡厅。听说那儿的咖啡不错，咱们去尝尝？
column2: There's a newly opened café near the school's east gate. I heard the coffee there is good — shall we go try it?

column1: 改天吧，我得去自习。
column2: Another day; I have to go study.

column1: 咱们就休息一会儿，放松放松！
column2: Let's just take a short break and relax a bit!

column1: 你知道309教室在哪儿吗？
column2: Do you know where classroom 309 is?

column1: 就是三层中间那个大教室。
column2: It's the big classroom in the middle of the third floor.

column1: 就在国际学生办公室旁边吗？
column2: Is it right next to the international students' office?

column1: 对。
column2: That's right.

column1: 明天下午那里有个关于新生选课的讲座！
column2: Tomorrow afternoon there's a lecture there about course selection for new students!

column1: 咱们可以顺便去看看那位最帅的老师！
column2: We can drop by and see that most handsome teacher while we're at it!

column1: 您好，我可以试一下吗？
column2: Hello, may I try this on?

column1: 当然，试衣间在那边。
column2: Of course, the fitting room is over there.

column1: （过了一会儿，爱华从试衣间出来）
column2: (After a while, Aihua comes out of the fitting room.)

column1: 这条有点儿大，有小一点儿的吗？
column2: This one is a bit big. Do you have a smaller size?

column1: 不好意思，黑色的没有小号的了。
column2: Sorry, we're out of small in black.

column1: 红色的可以吗？
column2: Would red be okay?

column1: 红色的很漂亮，不过我还是更喜欢黑色的。
column2: The red one is pretty, but I still prefer the black one.

column1: 您要黑色的，我可以帮您问问别的店。
column2: If you want the black one, I can ask another store for you.

column1: 这条裙子打折吗？
column2: Is this skirt on sale?

column1: 打七折。
column2: It's 30% off.

column1: 可以再便宜点儿吗？
column2: Could it be a bit cheaper?

column1: 对不起，我们最多打七折。
column2: Sorry, 30% off is the most we can do.

column1: 今年“双十一”网上的东西真便宜！
column2: The online deals on this year's "Double Eleven" are really cheap!

column1: 我想网购一双鞋，可是没有黄的了。
column2: I wanted to buy a pair of shoes online, but they were out of yellow.

column1: 那你买了什么颜色的？
column2: So what color did you buy?

column1: 没买，别的颜色我都不喜欢。我只买了几本书和一些本子。
column2: I didn't buy any; I didn't like the other colors. I only bought a few books and some notebooks.

column1: 我也买了很多书，不过我还是喜欢去商场买鞋和衣服。
column2: I bought a lot of books too, but I still prefer buying shoes and clothes at the mall.

column1: 网购可以节省时间。
column2: Shopping online can save time.

column1: 这倒是。我前几天在商场买了一条裙子，当时没货，今天还得去取。
column2: That's true. I bought a skirt at the mall a few days ago, but it was out of stock, so I still have to go pick it up today.

column1: 你可以给他们你的地址，让他们快递给你。
column2: You can give them your address and have them deliver it to you.

column1: 这个主意不错！
column2: That's a good idea!

column1: 欢迎光临，请问几位？
column2: Welcome. How many people, please?

column1: 两位。
column2: Two.

column1: 这边请。这是菜单。
column2: This way, please. Here's the menu.

column1: （点菜）
column2: (Ordering.)

column1: 你能吃辣的吗？他们这里的水煮鱼非常好！
column2: Can you eat spicy food? Their boiled fish in chili oil here is excellent!

column1: 太好了！我是四川人，从小就喜欢吃辣的。
column2: Great! I'm from Sichuan; I've loved spicy food since I was little.

column1: 来一份水煮鱼，要大份的。
column2: We'll have an order of boiled fish in chili oil — the large size.

column1: 今天西红柿炒鸡蛋半价，要尝尝吗？
column2: Tomato and scrambled eggs is half price today. Want to try it?

column1: 我不喜欢吃甜的。
column2: I don't like sweet food.

column1: 您看看这些特色菜，又好吃又便宜。
column2: Take a look at these specialty dishes — they're both delicious and cheap.

column1: 麻婆豆腐！又麻又辣！
column2: Mapo tofu! Both numbing and spicy!

column1: 服务员，请再给我们两个碗和一双筷子。
column2: Waiter, please bring us two more bowls and a pair of chopsticks.

column1: 好的，请稍等。
column2: Okay, one moment please.

column1: （饭后）
column2: (After the meal.)

column1: 这家餐馆儿的菜味道真好。
column2: The food at this restaurant tastes really good.

column1: 今天吃得太多了！我会长胖的。
column2: I ate too much today! I'm going to gain weight.

column1: 没关系！我们一会儿去锻炼！
column2: It's fine! We'll go exercise in a bit!

column1: 服务员，结账。请再给我们几张餐巾纸。
column2: Waiter, the check please. And please bring us a few more napkins.

column1: （结账后，两个人走出餐馆）
column2: (After paying, the two walk out of the restaurant.)

column1: 今天真开心，老板还送了咱们两份冰淇淋。
column2: What a fun day; the owner even gave us two servings of ice cream.

column1: 这是网上排名前十的餐厅。我们以后可以常来！
column2: This is one of the top ten restaurants online. We can come often from now on!

column1: 你选完课了吗？
column2: Have you finished choosing your courses?

column1: 还没呢。我想选中国文化。
column2: Not yet. I want to take Chinese Culture.

column1: 听说这门课的作业特别难。
column2: I heard the homework for this course is really hard.

column1: 所以我还没想好。你呢？
column2: That's why I haven't decided yet. And you?

column1: 我刚选完，这学期我选了五门课。
column2: I just finished; I chose five courses this semester.

column1: 你说我选不选中国文化？
column2: Do you think I should take Chinese Culture or not?

column1: 听说这门课的老师特别有名，写了很多书。
column2: I heard the teacher of this course is very famous and has written many books.

column1: 那我想好了！这学期我看看这位老师的书，下学期选他的课。
column2: Then I've decided! This semester I'll read this teacher's books, and next semester I'll take his course.

column1: 对了！明天下午有这位老师的讲座，你可以去听一听。
column2: By the way! There's a lecture by this teacher tomorrow afternoon; you can go listen.

column1: 太好了！谢谢你！
column2: Great! Thank you!

column1: 上周的考试你考得怎么样？
column2: How did you do on last week's exam?

column1: 有的题我没看懂，所以答错了。你呢？
column2: Some questions I didn't understand, so I got them wrong. And you?

column1: 我没复习好，有些生词没记住。
column2: I didn't review well; I didn't memorize some of the new words.

column1: 这次考试大家考得都不好，成绩都不太理想。
column2: Everyone did poorly on this exam; the grades weren't very good.

column1: 算了，别想了。下次考试前好好复习，肯定能考好。
column2: Never mind, don't think about it. Study hard before the next exam and you'll surely do well.

column1: 嗯。那咱们商量商量假期去哪儿旅行吧？
column2: Okay. So let's discuss where to travel during the holiday.

column1: 去上海怎么样？
column2: How about going to Shanghai?

column1: 好啊，我还没坐过中国的高铁，要是去上海，咱们就坐高铁去吧。
column2: Sure. I've never taken China's high-speed rail; if we go to Shanghai, let's take the high-speed train.

column1: 西田，朋友送来两张星星影城的电影票，是今天下午五点的，可是我有课，你拿去吧。
column2: Nishida, a friend gave me two movie tickets for Star Cinema, for five this afternoon, but I have class, so you take them.

column1: 好啊。我没去过星星影城，从学校怎么走呢？
column2: Sure. I've never been to Star Cinema. How do I get there from school?

column1: 坐公共汽车或者坐地铁都行。公共汽车先坐86路，然后换484路。
column2: You can take either the bus or the subway. For the bus, take the 86 first, then transfer to the 484.

column1: 学校附近经常堵车，坐公共汽车一定特别慢。
column2: There are often traffic jams near the school, so the bus would definitely be really slow.

column1: 那就坐地铁，地铁不堵车。15号线可以到。
column2: Then take the subway; the subway doesn't get stuck in traffic. Line 15 goes there.

column1: 学校离15号线地铁站有点儿远。
column2: The school is a bit far from the Line 15 subway station.

column1: 你可以骑自行车到地铁站啊！从学校到15号线，骑车最多十分钟。
column2: You can bike to the subway station! From school to Line 15, it's ten minutes by bike at most.

column1: 这是个好办法。
column2: That's a good idea.

column1: 喂，小雨，你到哪儿了？
column2: Hello, Xiaoyu, where are you now?

column1: 我还有一站就到了，下地铁后我应该怎么走？
column2: I'm one stop away. After I get off the subway, which way should I go?

column1: 你下地铁后，先坐电梯上来，然后找D口，从D口出来。
column2: After you get off the subway, take the elevator up, then find Exit D and come out through Exit D.

column1: 好的，从D口出去。
column2: Okay, out through Exit D.

column1: D口离你下地铁的地方比较远，不过离电影院最近。
column2: Exit D is a bit far from where you get off the subway, but it's the closest to the cinema.

column1: 出地铁后电影院好找吗？
column2: Is the cinema easy to find after leaving the subway?

column1: 我在地铁口等你。
column2: I'll wait for you at the subway exit.

column1: 行，一会儿见。
column2: Okay, see you soon.

column1: 听说你男朋友来了，假期有什么打算？
column2: I heard your boyfriend is here. What are your plans for the holiday?

column1: 我们俩都喜欢旅行，除了逛逛北京，我们还想去南方玩儿玩儿。
column2: We both like traveling. Besides looking around Beijing, we also want to travel around the south.

column1: 你们打算去哪些地方呢？
column2: Which places are you planning to go?

column1: 先去上海玩儿几天，然后去苏州逛两天，再到杭州玩儿三天。
column2: First a few days in Shanghai, then two days in Suzhou, then three days in Hangzhou.

column1: 你男朋友这次能在中国待多久？
column2: How long can your boyfriend stay in China this time?

column1: 他在中国待三周。
column2: He's staying in China for three weeks.

column1: 这是他第一次来中国吗？
column2: Is this his first time in China?

column1: 不是，他以前出差来过。
column2: No, he's been here before on a business trip.

column1: 那希望你们这次玩儿得高兴。
column2: Then I hope you two have a great time.

column1: 谢谢！也祝你假期愉快！
column2: Thank you! Have a happy holiday too!

column1: “十一”假期你去哪儿玩儿了？
column2: Where did you go during the National Day holiday?

column1: 我去西安了。
column2: I went to Xi'an.

column1: 怎么样？有意思吗？
column2: How was it? Was it interesting?

column1: 那还用说！我太爱西安了，我在那儿玩儿得都不想回来了。
column2: Need you ask! I love Xi'an so much; I had such a good time there I didn't want to come back.

column1: 你在西安待了多长时间？
column2: How long did you stay in Xi'an?

column1: 待了不到一周，我是前天回来的。
column2: Less than a week; I came back the day before yesterday.

column1: 你是怎么去的？是坐高铁去的吗？
column2: How did you get there? Did you take the high-speed rail?

column1: 我没买到高铁票，没办法，后来坐飞机去的。
column2: I couldn't get a high-speed rail ticket, so there was nothing I could do; I ended up flying.

column1: 你是跟谁一起去的？
column2: Who did you go with?

column1: 我一个人去的。不过路上认识了好几个新朋友，我们那天儿聊得特别开心。
column2: I went by myself. But I met several new friends on the way, and we chatted so happily that day.

column1: 你怎么才来？比赛九点半就开始了，都踢完一半了。
column2: Why are you only just arriving? The match started at nine thirty; it's already halfway through.

column1: 别提了，我八点半就出门了。
column2: Don't even mention it; I left home at eight thirty.

column1: 啊？那怎么这么晚才到？
column2: Huh? Then how come you're so late?

column1: 我坐错车了，坐了40分钟才发现。
column2: I got on the wrong bus and didn't realize it for 40 minutes.

column1: 下次可得看清楚再上车。
column2: Next time you'd better look carefully before getting on.

column1: 嗯，你说得对。哎，现在几比几了？
column2: Yeah, you're right. Hey, what's the score now?
3 to 2.

column1: 这比赛太激烈了！
column2: This match is so intense!

column1: 李君，你跑了几圈儿了？
column2: Li Jun, how many laps have you run?

column1: 三圈儿。来，跟我一起跑吧。
column2: Three laps. Come on, run with me.

column1: （跑了一圈后）
column2: (After running one lap.)

column1: 哎，咱们休息一下吧。
column2: Hey, let's take a break.

column1: 你刚跑了一圈儿，现在还不能休息，加油！
column2: You've only run one lap; you can't rest yet. Keep it up!

column1: 不行，我太累了，得坐一会儿。
column2: No, I'm too tired; I need to sit for a bit.

column1: 快起来，咱们再跑两圈儿。
column2: Get up, let's run two more laps.

column1: 不行，不行，还是你先跑吧。
column2: No, no, you go ahead and run first.

column1: 再坚持一下，你就不会觉得那么累了。
column2: Hang in there a little longer and you won't feel so tired.

column1: 小清，麻烦你帮我个忙，好吗？
column2: Xiaoqing, could you do me a favor?

column1: 没问题。
column2: No problem.

column1: 我想预订一张去南京的火车票，可是我不知道怎么在网上预订。
column2: I want to book a train ticket to Nanjing, but I don't know how to book online.

column1: 你要订哪天的？
column2: Which day do you want to book for?

column1: 15号的，最好是上午，不过别太早。
column2: The 15th, preferably in the morning, but not too early.

column1: 你坐高铁还是普通火车？高铁比普通火车贵三百来块钱。
column2: Are you taking the high-speed rail or a regular train? The high-speed rail is about 300 yuan more expensive than a regular train.

column1: 听说高铁快得多，是吗？
column2: I heard the high-speed rail is much faster, is that right?

column1: 对，普通火车要十四五个小时，高铁三四个小时就能到。
column2: Right, a regular train takes about fourteen or fifteen hours, while the high-speed rail gets there in three or four.

column1: 那还用问，当然坐高铁！
column2: No need to ask — of course the high-speed rail!

column1: 上午十点的，行吗？
column2: Ten in the morning, is that okay?

column1: 行，谢谢啊！
column2: Okay, thanks!

column1: 快放假了，咱们旅行住的宾馆预订好了吗？
column2: The holiday is almost here. Have we booked the hotel for our trip?

column1: 哎呀，我忘了！
column2: Oh no, I forgot!

column1: 听说假期房间比较紧张，最好早点儿订。
column2: I heard rooms are tight during the holiday; we'd better book early.

column1: 我现在就订。
column2: I'll book right now.

column1: 这个酒店看来不贵。
column2: This hotel doesn't look expensive.

column1: 不过这儿的房间快要订满了，单人间没有了。
column2: But the rooms here are almost fully booked; there are no single rooms left.

column1: 你看看这个标准间怎么样，价钱跟单人间差不多，有两张床。
column2: Take a look at this standard room — the price is about the same as a single, and it has two beds.

column1: 行，就订标准间吧。
column2: Okay, let's book the standard room.

column1: 姐姐，你是什么时候喜欢上西田的？
column2: Sis, when did you start liking Nishida?

column1: 从第一次见面开始。
column2: From the first time we met.

column1: 第一次见面？
column2: The first time you met?

column1: 当时教室的门开着，我看见一个男生坐在窗边。
column2: The classroom door was open at the time, and I saw a boy sitting by the window.

column1: 那个男生是西田？
column2: Was that boy Nishida?

column1: 他穿着一件白色的衬衫，手里拿着一本厚厚的书……
column2: He was wearing a white shirt and holding a thick book in his hands...

column1: 然后呢？
column2: And then?

column1: 然后我就喜欢上他了。
column2: And then I fell for him.

column1: 说来说去只是白色衬衫和一本书啊！还有别的吗？
column2: After all that, it's just a white shirt and a book! Is there anything else?

column1: 去机场接人都接错？！
column2: You went to pick someone up at the airport and got the wrong person?!

column1: 您告诉我，李经理个子高高的，穿着黑色的衬衫……
column2: You told me Manager Li was tall and wearing a black shirt...

column1: 手里拿着一个大大的文件包。那他就是李经理啊！
column2: ...and holding a big document bag. So he must be Manager Li!

column1: 他也姓李，也是经理。
column2: He's also surnamed Li and is also a manager.

column1: 说来说去，你觉得是我的错吗？
column2: So after all that, do you think it's my fault?

column1: 我错了。我现在马上去接李经理！
column2: I was wrong. I'll go pick up Manager Li right now!

column1: 等等！你做事总是马马虎虎。小红和你一起去吧！
column2: Wait! You're always so careless. Xiaohong, go with him!

column1: 那个眼睛大大的、头发短短的小红？
column2: That Xiaohong with the big eyes and short hair?

column1: 我知道了。
column2: Got it.

column1: 西田，你能把桌子上那张纸给我吗？
column2: Nishida, can you hand me that piece of paper on the table?

column1: 是这张吗？
column2: Is it this one?

column1: 不是，是黄色的。
column2: No, the yellow one.

column1: 哎呀，我把它扔了。
column2: Oh no, I threw it away.

column1: 扔了？！那是安装书柜的说明书。
column2: Threw it away?! That was the instruction manual for assembling the bookcase.

column1: 别着急，我一定把它找到！
column2: Don't worry, I'll definitely find it!

column1: 说明书呢？
column2: Where's the manual?

column1: 垃圾车已经运走了。
column2: The garbage truck has already taken it away.

column1: 没关系，我们上网查查，把书柜装好。
column2: It's okay, let's look it up online and put the bookcase together.

column1: 哎呀！我刚才下楼，不小心把手机丢了。
column2: Oh no! I just went downstairs and accidentally lost my phone.

column1: 我们把桌子放到窗户旁边吧。
column2: Let's put the table next to the window.

column1: 好！我们可以把书柜放到床旁边。
column2: Okay! We can put the bookcase next to the bed.

column1: 好啊！
column2: Sounds good!

column1: 谢谢你帮我搬家，连书柜都帮我擦干净了。
column2: Thank you for helping me move; you even cleaned the bookcase for me.

column1: 爱华，你有这本书！我找了很久了。
column2: Aihua, you have this book! I've been looking for it for a long time.

column1: 这是我的中文老师借给我的。
column2: My Chinese teacher lent it to me.

column1: 你可以把这本书借给我吗？
column2: Can you lend me this book?

column1: 可以！不过你一定别把这本书弄丢了。
column2: Sure! But you must not lose this book.

column1: 我周末要去女朋友家。送什么礼物比较好？
column2: I'm going to my girlfriend's house this weekend. What gift would be good to bring?

column1: 送玫瑰花吧！玫瑰花代表“我爱你”。
column2: Bring roses! Roses mean "I love you."

column1: 送水果吧，又好看又好吃。
column2: Bring fruit — it's both nice-looking and tasty.

column1: 也可以送茶叶。中国人喜欢一边喝茶，一边聊天儿。
column2: You could also bring tea. Chinese people like to chat while drinking tea.

column1: 你也可以自己做个礼物。
column2: You could also make a gift yourself.

column1: 对啊！我可以自己做个礼物。
column2: Right! I can make a gift myself.

column1: 好主意！
column2: Good idea!

column1: 带着礼物去女朋友家。太浪漫了！
column2: Going to your girlfriend's house with a gift. So romantic!

column1: 我饱了，我来帮忙吧。
column2: I'm full; let me help.

column1: 不用，你们去客厅坐着看电视吧。
column2: No need, go sit in the living room and watch TV.

column1: 我们来吧。一边聊天儿，一边洗碗，一会儿就洗完了。
column2: Let us do it. We'll chat while washing the dishes, and we'll be done in no time.

column1: 今天我的表现还好吗？
column2: Did I do all right today?

column1: 很好！大家都喜欢你的蛋糕，又好看又好吃！
column2: Very well! Everyone loved your cake — it looked great and tasted great!

column1: 我妈妈一直笑着夸你。
column2: My mom kept smiling and praising you.

column1: 真的？夸我什么？
column2: Really? Praising me for what?

column1: 我妈妈说西田又帅又能干！
column2: My mom said Nishida is both handsome and capable!

column1: 太好了！我下次为你们做我们家乡的特色菜。
column2: Great! Next time I'll make you the specialty dishes of my hometown.

column1: 你怎么回来了？不是去看电影了吗？
column2: Why are you back? Weren't you going to watch a movie?

column1: 倒霉！我不得不回来，刚出门我的自行车就被撞坏了。
column2: What bad luck! I had to come back; my bike got hit and broken right after I went out.

column1: 啊？怎么撞坏的？
column2: Huh? How did it get broken?

column1: 我不小心撞到树上了，现在腿还疼呢。
column2: I accidentally crashed into a tree, and my leg still hurts now.

column1: 你可真倒霉。
column2: You really are unlucky.

column1: 还有更倒霉的呢！我本来想给女朋友打个电话，可是太着急了，手机被我摔坏了！
column2: There's worse! I wanted to call my girlfriend, but I was in such a hurry that I dropped and broke my phone!

column1: 那你不去看电影了？
column2: So you're not going to the movie?

column1: 还看什么呀！快把手机借给我用用。
column2: Watch what movie! Hurry and lend me your phone.

column1: 喂，我是西田。
column2: Hello, it's Nishida.

column1: 西田！不是说看电影吗？你在哪儿？
column2: Nishida! Weren't we going to watch a movie? Where are you?

column1: 我在宿舍。
column2: I'm in the dorm.

column1: 你怎么还在宿舍？电影都快开始了，我等了你半天了。
column2: Why are you still in the dorm? The movie is about to start; I've been waiting for you for ages.

column1: 你别生气，我不是故意的。我的自行车被撞坏了。
column2: Don't be angry, I didn't do it on purpose. My bike got hit and broken.

column1: 自行车坏了，难道你不能给我打个电话吗？
column2: Your bike broke — couldn't you have called me?

column1: 我本来想打电话，可是手机被摔坏了。
column2: I did want to call, but my phone got dropped and broke.

column1: 上次手机丢了，这次手机坏了。你怎么这么粗心啊！
column2: Last time you lost your phone, this time it's broken. How can you be so careless!

column1: 我以后一定注意。
column2: I'll definitely be careful from now on.

column1: 小天，听说你住院了，大家都很关心你。
column2: Xiaotian, I heard you're in the hospital; everyone is worried about you.

column1: 谢谢你！我学滑雪的时候脚骨折了。
column2: Thank you! I broke my foot while learning to ski.

column1: 怎么这么不小心啊！医生说你什么时候能出院？
column2: How could you be so careless! When did the doctor say you can be discharged?

column1: 还得住一个星期。
column2: I still have to stay for another week.

column1: 这个医院怎么样？
column2: How is this hospital?

column1: 这里的医生不但水平高，而且很热情，就是这里的菜我不爱吃。
column2: The doctors here are not only highly skilled but also very warm; it's just that I don't like the food here.

column1: 你看，这是什么？
column2: Look, what's this?

column1: 啊，都是我爱吃的！
column2: Ah, it's all the food I love!

column1: 爷爷、奶奶好！这是送给你们的花儿和水果。
column2: Hello, Grandpa and Grandma! These flowers and fruit are for you.

column1: 谢谢你们！来，坐这边。
column2: Thank you! Come, sit over here.

column1: 你们在这儿住了多久了？
column2: How long have you been living here?

column1: 不到一年。因为孩子去国外了，不方便照顾我们，所以我们就来这儿住了。
column2: Less than a year. Because our children went abroad and can't easily take care of us, we came to live here.

column1: 这里生活方便吗？
column2: Is life convenient here?

column1: 在这儿不但生活方便，而且孩子们放心。因为这儿有专业的医生、护士，所以不用为看病担心。
column2: Here life is not only convenient, but our children can also relax. Because there are professional doctors and nurses here, we don't have to worry about medical care.

column1: 对老人来说，健康是最重要的。
column2: For the elderly, health is the most important thing.

column1: 爷爷、奶奶，我给你们唱首汉语歌吧！
column2: Grandpa, Grandma, let me sing you a Chinese song!

column1: 你还会唱汉语歌？真是多才多艺啊！
column2: You can even sing Chinese songs? You're really talented!

column1: 你好，请坐！请你先做一下自我介绍。
column2: Hello, please have a seat! Please introduce yourself first.

column1: 我叫文强，现在是北京体育大学的留学生。
column2: My name is Wenqiang; I'm currently an international student at Beijing Sport University.

column1: 你想当什么志愿者？
column2: What kind of volunteer do you want to be?

column1: 我想教孩子踢足球。
column2: I want to teach children to play soccer.

column1: 你为什么对这个感兴趣？
column2: Why are you interested in this?

column1: 我是足球专业的，如果可以教孩子踢足球，就能让更多的中国孩子了解足球，喜欢足球。
column2: I major in soccer. If I can teach children to play soccer, I can help more Chinese children learn about soccer and come to love it.

column1: 你都什么时间可以工作？
column2: When are you available to work?

column1: 我每周一、周三下午没有课，可以工作，周末也没问题。
column2: I have no classes on Monday and Wednesday afternoons, so I can work then, and weekends are fine too.

column1: 很好，欢迎你加入我们。
column2: Great, welcome to join us.

column1: 你好，张月。
column2: Hello, Zhang Yue.

column1: 您好！我很高兴有机会来参加今天的面试。
column2: Hello! I'm very glad to have the chance to take part in today's interview.

column1: 你以前做什么工作的？
column2: What did you do for work before?

column1: 我以前在一家饭店工作。
column2: I used to work at a restaurant.

column1: 你为什么要换工作呢？
column2: Why do you want to change jobs?

column1: 主要是为了孩子。原来工作的地方离我家太远了。
column2: Mainly for my child. My previous workplace was too far from home.

column1: 你觉得自己有什么优点？
column2: What do you think your strengths are?

column1: 我做事比较认真，遇到问题会马上想办法解决。
column2: I'm fairly conscientious in my work, and when I run into problems I immediately find a way to solve them.

column1: 缺点呢？
column2: And your weaknesses?

column1: 如果事情太多，我就容易着急。这是我应该改的地方。
column2: If there's too much to do, I get anxious easily. That's something I should work on.

column1: 好的，今天的面试就到这里，下周我们会给你通知。谢谢！
column2: Okay, that's it for today's interview. We'll let you know next week. Thank you!

column1: 喂，你听得到吗？我听不到。喂？
column2: Hello, can you hear me? I can't hear you. Hello?

column1: 喂，怎么这么吵？现在听得到吗？
column2: Hello, why is it so noisy? Can you hear me now?

column1: 现在听到了，你的声音有点儿小，大点儿声。
column2: I can hear you now; your voice is a bit soft, speak up a little.

column1: 那我再打一次。喂，这次听得到吗？
column2: Then I'll call again. Hello, can you hear me this time?

column1: 现在好了。你到哪儿了？十点到得了到不了？
column2: It's fine now. Where are you? Can you make it by ten?

column1: 我早就到了，你到哪儿了？
column2: I arrived a long time ago. Where are you?

column1: 我也到博物馆了。你在哪儿呢？
column2: I've reached the museum too. Where are you?

column1: 我们不是商量好在入口见吗？我一直在这儿等着呢。
column2: Didn't we agree to meet at the entrance? I've been waiting here the whole time.

column1: 我也在入口，为什么看不见你呢？
column2: I'm at the entrance too. Why can't I see you?

column1: 原来我在出口。
column2: It turns out I'm at the exit.

column1: 主任，咱们订的书送过来了。
column2: Director, the books we ordered have been delivered.

column1: 已经送上来了吗？在哪儿呢？
column2: Have they been brought up already? Where are they?

column1: 还没有，司机说车停在外面，开不进来，我现在出去看看。
column2: Not yet; the driver says the truck is parked outside and can't drive in. I'll go out and take a look now.

column1: 最好让他们直接搬上来，放到会议室去。
column2: It'd be best to have them carry the books straight up and put them in the meeting room.

column1: 司机说就剩下他一个人，恐怕得咱们自己搬。
column2: The driver says he's the only one left, so I'm afraid we'll have to carry them ourselves.

column1: 咱们自己怎么搬得动？你叫文强来帮忙吧。
column2: How can we carry them by ourselves? Ask Wenqiang to come help.

column1: 不好，我的书要掉下去了！文强，帮帮我！
column2: Oh no, my books are about to fall! Wenqiang, help me!

column1: 我现在也帮不了你，我也搬不动了。
column2: I can't help you right now either; I can't carry any more.

column1: 你们快把书放到推车上来！
column2: Quick, put the books on the cart!

column1: 这办法太好了！要不这么多书咱们肯定搬不了。
column2: That's a great idea! Otherwise we definitely couldn't move this many books.

column1: 文强，再往里一点儿，要不电梯关不上。
column2: Wenqiang, move in a bit more, or the elevator won't close.

column1: 你怎么看起来不太高兴？
column2: Why do you look a bit unhappy?

column1: 唉，中文越学越难，我在想要不要放弃。
column2: Sigh, the more I study Chinese the harder it gets; I'm wondering whether to give up.

column1: 怎么能放弃呢？只有坚持，才能胜利。
column2: How can you give up? Only by persevering can you succeed.

column1: 可是我觉得我的中文进步不大。
column2: But I feel my Chinese hasn't improved much.

column1: 怎么会呢？我们都觉得你进步很大，也很快。
column2: How could that be? We all think you've made great, fast progress.

column1: 谢谢你这样说。不过我还是很担心。
column2: Thank you for saying that. But I'm still worried.

column1: 你是在担心期末考试吗？
column2: Are you worried about the final exam?

column1: 被你看出来了。我一到考试就很紧张。
column2: You saw right through me. I get nervous whenever it's exam time.

column1: 你不要担心了，我们一起复习，肯定没问题的。
column2: Don't worry anymore; we'll review together and it'll definitely be fine.

column1: 祝贺你期末考试取得了好成绩！
column2: Congratulations on getting good results on the final exam!

column1: 谢谢你们，也谢谢大家对我的帮助！
column2: Thank you all, and thank you everyone for your help!

column1: 我们真舍不得你回国！
column2: We really don't want you to go back to your country!

column1: 是啊！感觉好像你刚到中国，马上又要离开了。
column2: Yeah! It feels like you just arrived in China and now you're leaving already.

column1: 我也觉得时间过得太快了。
column2: I feel time has passed too quickly too.

column1: 你回国以后是工作还是读书？
column2: After you go home, will you work or study?

column1: 我还没毕业，等回国以后要准备开学了。
column2: I haven't graduated yet; after I go home I'll get ready for the new term.

column1: 祝你学习进步！
column2: I wish you progress in your studies!

column1: 谢谢！认识你们是我在中国最开心的事。
column2: Thank you! Meeting you all has been the happiest part of my time in China.

column1: 来！为咱们的友谊干杯！
column2: Come on! A toast to our friendship!

column1: 我们会想你的。以后有机会一定再到中国来。
column2: We'll miss you. Come back to China whenever you get the chance.

column1: 谢谢你们，我也会想你们的。
column2: Thank you all; I'll miss you too.
